purpose: Explain the workshop library's structure and access

required_facts.fact: The library consolidates YouTube, GitHub, conference and Slack material.
Claude Code converts READMEs into multi-part tutorials.
Agent workshops cover MCP, PydanticAI and coding agents.
The safety workshop uses input and output guardrails.
Deployment workshops cover Railway, CI/CD and Lambda.
Most workshops are free and deployment is membership content.
AI Hero moved from email into a tracked seven-day course.

author_attribution: Attribute platform and workshop work to Alexey and preserve Valeriia's original site contribution.
